property_summary: For all admissible inputs, if Collect(_am) succeeds for a caller whose pre-call balance is below MinSum, then that caller's balance must not decrease: only calls with balances[msg.sender] >= MinSum may modify balances, which the mutant's weakened guard violates.
change_summary: Weaken the Collect guard so MinSum is no longer required, allowing balance-changing collects for sums below MinSum.
